cafresohq_ui.//: The HQ app UI (hq.html + jsx + css + assets), served from ICP so UI updates are a ~1-min dfx deploy instead of a container rebuild. serve.py becomes API-only; this UI calls it cross-origin (?api=<base>). build_hq_ui.py assembles hq-ui/ from the repo-root UI files.

cafresohq_state.//: Phase 2 on-chain per-user state (HQ docs + vetKeys-encrypted vault ciphertext), keyed by II principal. Also holds agent-wallet policy + ICP-service flags, AND hosts published sites (Publish-to-Canister) served publicly via http_request at https://<this-canister>.icp0.io/<principal>/<project>/. Browser is the only writer. See docs/PHASE2_STATE_CANISTER.md + docs/PUBLISH_TO_CANISTER.md.

cafresohq_market.//: The hiring hall (North Star §6 Phase C): listings of coworkers for hire from the network, jobs with real ICRC-2 escrow held per job, an append-only on-chain résumé per listing, worker keys linked by their operator, plan-admin dispute rulings. Separate from cafresohq_state on purpose: held funds get their own cycle balance and blast radius. See docs/AGENT_MARKETPLACE.md.
